brief.subject: LLM과 AI 산업의 이해 — Day 01 인트로
brief.goal: s01 직전 15초 오프닝 모션 릴: 강의의 흐름(뉴런 → 형태 → 깊이 → 어텐션 → 토큰 → 프롬프트 → 스케일)을 9컷으로 예고

visualStyle.medium: 2D vector motion graphics (SVG): flat Swiss color fields, geometric shape motifs, a projected 3D cube, halftone dots
visualStyle.lighting: Flat solid color field per shot (reel-* tokens); no gradients
visualStyle.typography: Archivo Black for Latin display, Pretendard 900 for the Korean title, Playfair Display Italic accent, JetBrains Mono four-corner HUD
visualStyle.density: One idea per shot, big type, generous negative space
visualStyle.cameraFeeling: Locked frame; hard cuts on the beat, elements whip in with directional motion blur

beats.visual: Black field: a cream line draws, a red ball drops and bounces with a dotted trail — a neuron's signal
Red field: MAKE slams in from the right, IT (cream) follows, THINK. whips in from the left; the cream dot pops
Cream field: a red square morphs to a cross, then a hexagon, with blue/yellow ghosts and an annotated bounding box — a perceptron's shape
Blue field: a 2×2×2 cube spins, splits into cubelets with black seams, then scatters with motion blur — deep layers
Black field: a halftone ring breathes and turns; a few red dots light up across the grid — attention
Black field: two striped ribbons (red/pink/cream, yellow/blue) snake across the frame — tokens flowing
Cream field: a cursor flies in and clicks a toggle; it turns red with a ripple — the prompt moment
Yellow field: a black-rayed sun spins out of a red core; cut to blue: a planet with two tilted orbits and fast moons — scale
Cream field: Korean title lines whip in from both sides, the italic serif 'Day 01' reveals, the red ball from shot 1 drops in as the full stop; rule and footer type in
beats.notes: HUD bottom-left: 09  FIN. Hold from 14.0 s; nothing new appears after 13.9 s.

mustKeep: red ball returns as the title's full stop

audio.soundDesign: Bounce plucks under the signal, impact on the first cut, a slam per word, ticks on the morph, whooshes on the cube split/scatter, sparkles for attention, swish for the ribbons, a click for the toggle, sun impact, riser into the title impact, a kick + bell when the ball lands
audio.music: Procedural Web Audio (code, no samples, no generative AI): 120 BPM kick/clap/hat groove with bass and stabs, Am – F – C – G – Am – Dm – E, resolving on A major under the title. Rendered offline from a fixed seed and played in sync with the scene clock.
